posts.title: Time to First Call Now Measures an Agent, Not a Developer
posts.description: Time to first call was the favourite DevRel onboarding number. Now an agent often makes that first call. What the evidence says to measure next.

posts.title: TIL: TypeScript satisfies Checks Your Object and Keeps Its Keys
posts.description: The TypeScript satisfies operator checks an object against a type but keeps its real key names, so a typo in a key becomes a compile error.
